entries.workflow: Create or edit a flexible membership type
entries.summary: Reviewed demo evidence for creating and inspecting a flexible membership type in the embedded Memberships app. Flexible membership type setup belongs in Membership Types. Member profiles are used later to assign or review an existing type for one member.

routes.name: Create a flexible membership type
routes.actor: Golf club admin or membership staff user
preconditions: Flexible Membership is enabled for the club if the Flex option is expected to be available.
The club knows the membership type name, active/inactive status, any age or service eligibility rules, and any default subscriptions.
steps: In Membership Type Details, enter the Name.
Choose Select Membership Type Status. Observed options are Active and Inactive.
Use Minimum Age and Maximum Age only if the type should be age-limited.
Use Qualifying Length of Service only if eligibility depends on years of service.
Use Next Chained Membership Type only if members should later move automatically to another type.
In Subscription Items, use Start typing to filter available subscriptions and Select to add any default subscriptions.
routes.outcome: The membership type is created with Flex enabled.
verification: Confirm the Flex column shows Yes.
Open the membership type and confirm the Flex checkbox is checked and default subscription items are correct.

routes.name: Inspect or edit an existing flexible membership type
routes.actor: Golf club admin or membership staff user
preconditions: The flexible membership type already exists.
steps: Check Membership Type Details and confirm Flex is checked.
Review Default Items for default subscriptions.
Use EDIT if the membership type details need to change.
Use the Members table on the detail view to check which members are assigned to that membership type.
routes.outcome: The staff user can verify or amend the flexible membership type configuration.
verification: Return to Membership Types and confirm the row still shows the expected status and Flex value.

variants.name: Managing one flexible member
variants.appliesWhen: The user asks about one member's flexible membership, points, balance, top-up, clawback, or account balance.
variants.answerImpact: Use Members to open the member profile and Account Balances for wallet movement. Do not use the create membership type route as the main answer.

variants.name: Flexible wallets dashboard visibility
variants.appliesWhen: The user asks why flexible wallets are or are not shown on the Memberships Dashboard.
variants.answerImpact: Use Memberships > Settings > General and the Display Flexible Wallets table on dashboard checkbox.

variants.name: Wallet/account setup
variants.appliesWhen: The user asks about configuring wallets, account units, auto assignment, active state, or minimum balance.
variants.answerImpact: Use Memberships > Accounts, not Membership Types.
